_notes.setup: AvalonLogs (WhoaWhoa 2022), 12,393 usable games. Half of every player count is the hidden test set (eval/test/heldout.dat, 6,197 games); the rest are visible in data/avalonlogs_raw (6,196 usable). Each game yields one instance: the public history up to one uniformly sampled completed quest (the paper samples one quest per game) seen from one viewpoint, views balanced within a player count.
_notes.paper_numbers: results hold the paper's Table 8 marginal accuracies unchanged. The paper evaluated a sampled quest on the subset of games with LLM runs; this gym evaluates the full held-out split, so the paper numbers are on the same scale but are not targets.
_notes.ranking: Every *_brier metric has coefficient 1 (lower is better); *_marginal metrics have coefficient 0.
